_meta.description: Committed 'past outputs' fixture for --replay mode (INT-01). Keyed by corpus case id. Each value is { text, candidates }: `text` pins the exact entry text the fixture was captured against (so a later corpus edit that changes a case's text is caught as a mismatch instead of silently scoring stale evidence) and `candidates` is the array of RAW candidate objects a model call would have returned (runCorpusEval.js JSON.stringifies just the `candidates` array before feeding it to the real extractIntentCandidates/parseCandidatesResponse, so replay mode exercises the exact same string-parsing path a live call would).
_meta.provenance: HAND-AUTHORED for this task, not captured from a real Gemini call (no live key was exercised in this task). It stands in for a real captured-from-a-live-run snapshot so --replay mode and the scoring logic can be exercised hermetically in CI. Before this becomes a genuine prompt/model regression gate, run `node runCorpusEval.js --live` once against real Gemini with a valid key and commit ITS raw output as the new replayFixture.json (see CORPUS_EVAL.md).

intentionalImperfections.zero-2: Injects a hallucinated candidate (a dream mis-read as a real commitment) that reaches 'active' with no corresponding expected intent -> exercises the hallucination/false-positive path in corpusScoring.js.
intentionalImperfections.temporal-4: Omits the expected active candidate entirely (model returns []) -> exercises the not-proposed/false-negative (recall miss) path.
intentionalImperfections.openloop-clear-3: Mislabels the candidate's kind as 'task' instead of the expected 'open_loop' (still explicit-command, still activates) -> exercises the kind-confusion path.
